title: Recover supplier payment posting
intro: Complete accounting for a retained, executed payment whose posting failed. Recovery preserves invoice paid amounts and supplier balances, and keeps bank reconciliation separate.
empty: No recorded payments match this search.
independent: Recovery requires an authorized user other than the original requester and approver.
effect: Post the retained payment to the existing ledger. Paid allocations and supplier balances are preserved. The resolved posting exception remains in history; a statement-matching obligation stays open.
ready: Review these current accounting inputs before confirming. They will be checked again at submission.
pending: A confirmation reference is retained. Retry this exact recovery to resolve its outcome. Do not record the payment again.
passwordFailed: Password verification failed. Check your password and try again.
stillUnsettled: Posting alone does not establish settlement. Review statement reconciliation for its current outcome.
denied: Current access does not allow this operation. Sign in again or ask the administrator to review permissions.
freshRequired: Verify your password before confirming recovery.
stale: Payment or accounting setup changed. Review the current recovery preview again.
conflict: This confirmation reference belongs to different recovery terms. Inspect the retained record before proceeding.
evidenceRequired: Execution, paid-balance or accounting evidence requires review. Inspect retained source records; do not create replacement payment evidence.
conditions: Current accounting or reconciliation conditions prevent recovery. Ask the accounting owner to review the posting rules, accounts, journals and retained records.
invalid: Choose a retained payment and review it before confirming.
unknown: The outcome could not be confirmed. Keep this reference and retry the same recovery.
loadFailed: Posting data could not be loaded. Retry; an empty list has not been confirmed.
storage: The browser could not retain the confirmation reference. Enable session storage before recovery.

blockers.ALREADY_POSTED: This payment is already posted. Inspect its retained journal instead of posting it again.
blockers.BATCH_REVIEW: The failed batch has incomplete, reversed or conflicting journal evidence. An accounting review is required.
blockers.RECONCILIATION_REVIEW: Matching, settlement or other reconciliation work already exists. Review those obligations before changing the posting state.
blockers.PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE: Exactly one open period must cover the original accounting date and match the retained batch.
blockers.CURRENCY_REVIEW: The recorded payment currency differs from the current organization currency. Review the historical currency treatment.
blockers.COUNTRY_SETUP: Complete the reviewed country accounting setup before recovery.
blockers.RULE_UNAVAILABLE: An applicable supplier-payment posting rule is missing or needs review.
blockers.JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE: Configure exactly one active default journal for this payment method.
